name: Krefeld Condensed
description: Tall narrow capitals with firm upright strokes, close proportions and clean counters.
origin: From the HOLLÄNDISCHE KUNSTAUSSTELLUNG lettering on Jan Thorn Prikker’s 1903 poster for the Dutch art exhibition at the Kaiser Wilhelm Museum in Krefeld. Printed by S. Lankhout & Co. in The Hague, it advertised the exhibition held May 20–August 2, 1903.

name: Railway 1901
description: Broad upright capitals with fine serifs, strong stroke contrast, wide R bowls and curled leg terminals.
origin: From The Railway Magazine’s October 1901 cover, no. 52, volume IX. The source photograph and matching historical scan show the same issue; the cover artist and letterer are unidentified, and editor G. A. Sekon is not an artist credit.
